about: AP Environmental Science concept dependency map (docs/apenv-spec.md, docs/apenv-phase0.md): the 99 topics of the CED in order, the "Math you need" skills with the topic each comes before, and every concept with the topic that teaches it, the concepts it depends on and, for notation, the TeX patterns that use it. Our own words; no CED text. Checked by scripts/check-apenv-map.mjs.

ced.edition: Effective Fall 2026, V.1 (9 units, 99 topics; minor clarifications only)
ced.note: Built from docs/apenv-ced-map.json, itself from docs/apenv-research/framework.md. Objectives beyond Topic 3.7 unverified (docs/apenv-needs-author.md, ced-text).

everydayWords.about: Common words a student already roughly knows. They may be used in their everyday sense before the topic that teaches them; the technical terms of the same concept stay strict ("nitrogen fixation", "carrying capacity", "photochemical smog" are not used early).
